thread.title: Amazon's stock surges toward 7th-straight gain, and 5th-straight record

author: morningstar.com
title: Amazon's stock surges toward 7th-straight gain, and 5th-straight record
text:
Shares of Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) rallied 1% in morning trade Friday, putting it on track to close at yet another record high. The e-commerce giant's stock is headed for a seventh-straight gain, and fifth straight record close. The stock had recorded six-straight record closes, and seven-straight gains, on March 12. The stock has now run up 4.0% during its win streak, adding about $31.0 billion in market capitalization. Amazon's market cap of $798.4 billion ranks second, behind Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) $930.9 billion and just ahead of Alphabet Inc.'s (GOOGL) $788.4 billion. The stock has outperformed the broader consumer discretionary sector, as the SPDR Consumer Discretionary Select Sector ETF (XLY) has gained 1.5% over the past 7 sessions. Amazon is the ETF's most heavily weighted components. The S&P 500 has inched up 0.2% over the past seven sessions. Earlier this week, Amazon expanded its discounts (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/amazon-prime-member-discounts-expand-to-121-additional-whole-foods-markets-2018-05-30) on Whole Foods Market sale items for Prime members, the company said it was adding 1,500 new workers in Oklahoma (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/amazon-adds-1500-workers-with-first-oklahoma-fulfillment-center-2018-05-29) with its first fulfillment center in that state and MKM Partners raised its stock price target to $1,840, calling Amazon the "best long-term growth story (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/amazons-stock-price-target-raised-as-analyst-calls-it-the-best-long-term-growth-story-2018-05-29)" of mega-cap stocks.
-Tomi Kilgore; 1130ET
